evals.prompt: Run a 10-second training experiment using time_budget_train.py with experiment ID exp001. Record to results.tsv.
evals.expected_output: Training completes within budget. results.tsv has one row with id=exp001, val_score logged, status=KEEP or DISCARD.
assertions: status is KEEP, DISCARD, or CRASH

evals.prompt: Demonstrate the 3-crash circuit breaker: run 3 experiments that all crash and verify the system escalates to the user rather than continuing.
evals.expected_output: After 3 consecutive CRASHes, agent outputs escalation message to user explaining the repeated failures and requesting guidance.
assertions: Escalation message identifies the error pattern
